description.value:
Duration constant

Any effect you apply to yourself that has a stated duration and that changes your own body — including Adaptive Membrane, a Skinwalker Bloodline feature, or a comparable Graft — lasts twice as long.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element generically doubles the duration of an arbitrary already-applied effect -- this would require a predicate hook on every other card's own duration field, which doesn't exist as a modifiable target.
